quotes.text: Stripe doesn’t email every receipt it creates.
even if **Successful payments** is turned off.
Receipts don’t expire, but for security reasons, links to receipts expire after 30 days.
Branding settings don’t control whether Stripe sends receipts.

findings: The 2026-11-07 guide expands general receipts into explicit creation versus sending, automatic receipt eligibility and recipient precedence, manual sending, expiring links, paid invoices, and Dashboard/locale/Connect ownership settings.

Successful payments and refunds generate receipts, including invoice and subscription payments; automatic payment emails require eligibility, and delayed payments wait for success. An explicit live-mode PaymentIntent receipt_email bypasses the Successful payments toggle; Checkout passes payment_intent_data.receipt_email.

One-time Checkout and Payment Links can create a separately scoped paid invoice when enabled. Payment success and automatic receipts precede delivery. The itemized invoice is distinct from a standard receipt, and page, email and invoice localization have different rules.
substantive_changes: Substantive new coverage includes successful payment/refund receipt creation vs optional email, recipient/public details/live-mode prerequisites, success and delayed timing, explicit receipt-email precedence and toggle override, PDF download language and link renewal mechanics.

Itemized paid invoice enablement and post-success sending for one-time Payment Links/Checkout, separate Checkout API pricing, invoice.paid and customization, plus separate locale rules and required support fields merit retrieval.

Connect settings ownership remains platform for destination charges and separate charges/transfers and connected account for direct charges. The November text names PaymentIntent create for a platform receipt_email and spells out branding’s appearance-only role.
Use-case router, new sections, reorganization and Terminal vs Billing cross-link substitutions are structural or navigational; absent old local shortcuts are not proved unavailable.
historical_claims_to_preserve: May receipt number, related Charge URL reflecting refund/latest state, 30-day receipt link expiry with original-email reissue, and manual send/10-entry history remain useful supporting evidence.

Preserve May's separately scoped refunds-to-original-charge-email and Mexico Dashboard download with status/type, separate Hosted Invoice Page downloads for subscription/invoice receipts, and subscription/invoice receipt itemization.
Preserve both dated PDF and test automatic-send accounts, April advanced PaymentIntent recipient wording, and stable Connect ownership/branding routes.
conflicts: The 2026-05-11 snapshot and current summary say direct download of Stripe-hosted receipts is unavailable, while the 2026-11-07 overview explicitly permits PDF downloads. Keep older Hosted Invoice Page download and Mexico Dashboard refund-download pathways separately scoped; retain the two dates without inferring universal PDF rollout.

The 2026-05-11 test-receipt section describes possible automatic sends to the operator or a verified user with testing-environment access. The 2026-11-07 guide says test payments do not trigger automatic receipt emails and directs to manual send. Preserve the dated conflict without assuming an observed rollout.

The 2026-11-07 general guide prioritizes an explicit receipt email and otherwise Customer email; its 2026-04-22 advanced Payment Intents counterpart raw/stripe-email-receipts-2025.md:142-148 says receipt_email is additional to Customer and additional configured recipients. Keep distinct date/integration scopes and avoid universal exclusivity or duplication claims.

The 2026-04-20 Checkout companion excludes invoice_creation with manual capture (raw/stripe-checkout-receipts-2025.md:44), a condition the November overview does not restate. Its Checkout logo guidance lists JPG, PNG and GIF (raw/stripe-checkout-receipts-2025.md:22); November's Email receipts logo/icon settings list PNG and JPG (new raw lines 155-174). Preserve both source scopes and dates without inferring a GIF capability change.
unresolved_questions: The captures leave unresolved how current receipt PDF presentation, test automatic email and advanced-integration recipient multiplicity behave across account and Checkout configurations.

answers.Q1: For https://docs.stripe.com/receipts, the independent 2026-11-07 capture states that Stripe creates a receipt for all successful payments and refunds, including invoice/subscription payments, and customers can view it online or download PDFs. Creation and emailing are distinct (new raw lines 5-19). The business supplies public contact details and recipient email (explicit first, then Customer; Customer object optional), uses live mode and turns on the relevant Dashboard setting. Payment email waits for success, even for delayed methods, and an explicit PaymentIntent receipt_email sends on live-mode success with Successful payments off; Checkout uses payment_intent_data.receipt_email (new raw lines 21-44). Business operators can manually send or resend, including for test payments; receipt links expire after 30 days while the receipt persists, and for an expired link the customer provides the original transaction email and Stripe sends a fresh link to that same address (new raw lines 48-71). One-time Payment Links and Checkout can create an itemized post-payment invoice when enabled; automatic receipts are needed to email, and successful payment precedes sending (new raw lines 73-114). Both captures use platform Customer emails, Branding and Public details for destination charges and separate charges and transfers, and the connected account's corresponding settings for direct charges. November specifies platform-supplied receipt_email at PaymentIntent creation and says Branding controls appearance independently of sending. A connected account using the Stripe Dashboard can configure appearance there, while a platform configures appearance through settings.branding for connected accounts without that Dashboard (old raw lines 56-66 and new raw lines 209-219). The mapped source-stripe-receipts summary is based on the 2026-05-11 capture and describes Charge receipt_url, manual sends, Mexico refund PDFs, subscription/invoice receipts and Connect ownership (old raw lines 8-12, old raw lines 25-29, old raw lines 42-50), but its blanket no-download and verified-test automatic-send statements differ from the November guide (old raw line 10 and old raw lines 52-54; new raw line 9, new raw line 27 and new raw lines 61-63).
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/receipts, source-stripe-receipts should document that the 2026-11-07 capture adds substantive payment/refund eligibility, recipient precedence and toggle override (new raw lines 21-44), one-time Checkout/Payment Links invoice configuration, PDF delivery and success timing (new raw lines 73-114), and branding, required business details and channel-specific locale rules (new raw lines 140-219). Preserve the difference between invoice locale, browser receipt locale and email locale; Connect appearance configuration does not decide transmission. The use-case table, section rearrangement and Terminal cross-link are navigation or presentation (new raw lines 11-19 and new raw lines 221-224 versus old raw lines 68-71). The source-stripe-receipts summary should retain the May 11 Charge/refund/latest-state and itemized invoice/Hosted Invoice Page details (old raw lines 8-12 and old raw lines 42-50), show both dates for the direct-download and verified-test-email conflicts (old raw line 10, old raw line 54, new raw line 9 and new raw lines 23-27), and preserve the April 22 advanced Payment Intents guidance about receipt_email being additional alongside the November general precedence wording (raw/stripe-email-receipts-2025.md:142-148, new raw lines 23-25 and new raw lines 38-44). Retain the reciprocal stripe-payment-intents source route, link the new paid-invoice path through stripe-checkout with its existing source-stripe-checkout-receipts companion. The April 20 Checkout capture explicitly excludes using invoice_creation with payment_intent_data[capture_method]=manual (raw/stripe-checkout-receipts-2025.md:44). November's general Checkout steps leave that condition unstated (new raw lines 92-108). April's Checkout branding guidance lists JPG, PNG and GIF for its logo (raw/stripe-checkout-receipts-2025.md:22), while the November Email receipts logo/icon table lists PNG and JPG (new raw lines 155-174). Attribute the formats to those dated contexts and leave a GIF rollout or removal unestablished. Keep the Terminal receipts route separate for in-person use (new raw lines 15-19).
